marta_csops: Heads-up — I'm seeing a surge of duplicate onboarding nudges from the playbook runner for the past ~3h. Examples in logs: acct 9921, 9921, 11002 repeated within 10m windows. Not traffic spike — looks like a playbook loop (maybe recent schedule change).

daniel_csm: how many affected? rough estimate?

marta_csops: ~420 unique accounts got 2+ nudges, ~60 got 3+. time window: 09:12–12:30 UTC.

raj_dataeng: ugh. can you grab the last run id from the runner logs? also we should find which rule fired twice. run this quick query (dry):

```sql
SELECT account_id, event_type, COUNT(*) as hits
FROM playbook_events
WHERE created_at BETWEEN now() - interval '4 hours' AND now()
  AND playbook_name = 'onboard-nudge-v2'
GROUP BY account_id, event_type
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY hits DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

marta_csops: attaching run id: run-2024-06-24-09-05 (from runner). Looks like the cron rescheduled overlapping runs after the change to the backoff window.

lina_enablement: what’s the customer impact? any replies/negative csat so far? should we pause outgoing emails first?

marta_csops: no high-severity replies yet but 3 customers flagged unexpected duplicates in Intercom. my recommendation: flip the playbook master switch to OFF (safe toggle), pause outbound channel for email templates, then do a dry-run + small shadow-run to validate fixes.

daniel_csm: +1 to safe toggle. we should also prepare a short apology template if emails already went out. Lina can you draft?

lina_enablement: on it. draft will say: "Sorry for duplicate messages — we're pausing automated nudges and will follow up with your CSM." sending in #enablement in 10m. :writing_hand:

marta_csops: quick toggle command (admin API):

```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood-inference.internal/api/playbooks/toggle \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"playbook":"onboard-nudge-v2","enabled":false}'
```

playbook-bot: automation: run run-2024-06-24-09-05 finished, 1.2k events processed, 422 duplicate-detection alerts emitted. (system)

raj_dataeng: after toggle, run this to identify the offending schedule overlap (dry-run):

```sql
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT id, scheduled_at, started_at, finished_at
  FROM playbook_runs
  WHERE name = 'onboard-nudge-v2' AND scheduled_at > now() - interval '6 hours'
)
SELECT * FROM runs
WHERE scheduled_at BETWEEN started_at - interval '5 minutes' AND started_at + interval '5 minutes';
```

marta_csops: toggled and paused emails. outbound queue drained.

lina_enablement: draft apology posted. also adding manual outreach instructions for CSMs handling affected accounts.

daniel_csm: after we stabilize, can we gate nudges on healthscore so low-health accounts (still onboarding) don't get churn nudges? we should avoid hitting customers with low engagement repeatedly.

marta_csops: agree. propose adding a health gating rule: only nudge if health_score >= 30 OR last_activity < 14 days. sample config snippet for playbook rule: 

```json
{
  "playbook": "onboard-nudge-v2",
  "gating": {
    "type": "health_score",
    "min_score": 30,
    "fallback": "shadow_run"
  },
  "shadow_run": true
}
```

raj_dataeng: also recommend enabling a 24h shadow run mode for one rollout window to compare counts (no sends). Then promote. I can add a CI check that flags when scheduled_at delta between consecutive runs < min_interval (configurable).

marta_csops: can we add a quick telemetry alert for duplicate detections? something like: if duplicates detected > 50 in 1h, paging to csops channel + run auto-toggle?

daniel_csm: yes — set threshold, but keep auto-toggle conservative. prefer human approval first.

lina_enablement: assigning manual outreach owners: CSM cohort A (owners listed) will handle accounts with >2 duplicates; CS Ops will review others. I'll update the tracker.

marta_csops: follow-ups: 1) raj -> add CI schedule delta check + run query; 2) raj -> create alert rule (dupes > 50/hr); 3) lina -> outreach template; 4) daniel -> confirm human rollback policy and owners. I'll re-enable playbook to shadow_run only after checks.

playbook-bot: alert: outbound queue drained successfully.

daniel_csm: thanks everyone. keep this thread updated when shadow run starts. :white_check_mark:

marta_csops: noted — will post run id and sample diffs when available.
